steps.title: Meet My Blocks
steps.text: My Blocks are blocks you make yourself! Put a group of blocks you use often into one block with your own name. Let's take a quick tour.

steps.title: Make a block
steps.text: Click this button, type a name, and press OK. A “define” block appears in your code area.

steps.title: Put blocks under “define”
steps.text: Whatever you attach under the “define” hat block is what runs each time your new block is used. For example, turn and move to make a shape!

steps.title: Add inputs
steps.text: Click “Add an input” while you make the block to let it take numbers or text. Then each time you use it, you can give it a different value, like how big a square should be.

steps.title: Use your block
steps.text: Your new block now appears in this palette. Drag it into any script and it will run what's under its “define” block. Change the definition once, and every use updates!
